description: A lectern with a five-page written book open at page 3, on classic_flat (surface y=-61, stone floor), seen from the south: a comparator behind it (south, facing north) reads 8 into a line of dust running south. -McUse=2,-60,2 opens the book screen.

lecterns.title: Field Notes
lecterns.author: Steve
pages: Day one. Found a village by the river and traded wheat for emeralds.
Day two. The iron golem followed me to the edge of the fields and no further.

Day three. Built a lectern so these notes stay put.

A comparator behind it reads which page is open: page 3 of 5 gives 8.
Day four. Rain all day. Fished from the dock.
